english.title: Manufacturer fail to inform authority of risk presented by non-conforming pyrotechnic article (not F1/F2/F3 firework)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a manufacturer who considered or had reason to believe that a pyrotechnic article other than a category F1, F2 or F3 firework, namely **(..SPECIFY PYROTECHNIC ARTICLE..), which you had placed on the market was not in conformity with Part 2 of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015 and that article presented a risk, failed to immediately inform the

(A)_[market surveillance authority]_
(B)_[competent national authorities of any member State in which you had made the firework available on the market]_

of the risk, giving details of the respect in which it was considered not to be in conformity with Part 2 and any corrective measures taken
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 22(2), 62(1)(k) and 63(2) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) applies (i.e. a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is summary only - see offence document H12256 (CJS code PA15019)

other.penalty:

Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine
